description: A structured 90-day journey to understand the portfolio, build trusted partnerships, deliver one practical AI optimization and establish a sustainable operating model.
roleMission: Build trust, deliver practical value and establish a sustainable AI capability across the portfolio.
operatingModel: Understand organizations, workflows, tools, dashboards and business context.
Explore manual effort, human-error risk and capacity gaps with stakeholders.
Deliver one practical, measurable optimization and create a credible path forward.
journeyPrinciples: Understand the organization, business context and existing AI landscape.
Explore opportunities with stakeholders and evidence.
Deliver one practical and measurable optimization.
Establish a sustainable operating model for continued transformation.

90: Prioritized six-month roadmap and operating model

phaseSuccessCriteria.30: Access, organizational context and priority stakeholder relationships are established; an initial opportunity backlog exists.
phaseSuccessCriteria.60: Opportunities are validated and prioritized; the first practical solution is defined with measurable success criteria.
phaseSuccessCriteria.90: A practical solution is delivered or piloted; value is measured and the roadmap and working model are aligned.

suggestedResources: Opportunity backlog and delivery planning resources

weeks.title: Foundation and enablement
weeks.focus: Become operational and prepare the learning and stakeholder plan.
activities: Secure access to AI tools, collaboration systems, analytics and shared resources
Review the studio, portfolio, business-unit and leadership structure

weeks.title: Initial immersion
weeks.focus: Observe how the first game teams operate and begin guided exploration.
activities: Join selected team routines and meet priority stakeholders
Explore dashboards, systems and the metrics used by initial teams

weeks.title: Broader immersion
weeks.focus: Broaden learning and prepare high-value stakeholder conversations.
activities: Continue stakeholder introductions and document workflow context
Map the tools, dashboards and measures used across functions

weeks.title: Discovery consolidation
weeks.focus: Consolidate open questions and identify themes worth deeper exploration.
activities: Document manual effort, error exposure and capacity constraints
Create a structured list of questions, assumptions and follow-ups

weeks.title: First-month synthesis
weeks.focus: Turn discovery into an initial opportunity backlog.
activities: Summarize organization, workflows, tools and business context
Create an initial AI opportunity backlog for stakeholder validation

weeks.title: Portfolio mapping approach
weeks.focus: Define a repeatable portfolio discovery and mapping method.
activities: Create a consistent method for mapping workflow maturity and tool usage
Set recurring routines with the most relevant stakeholders

weeks.title: Workflow opportunity mapping
weeks.focus: Map the strongest operational themes where AI can create value.
activities: Identify time-consuming work, rework and human-error exposure
Identify capacity gaps suitable for automation support

weeks.title: Backlog validation
weeks.focus: Validate hypotheses and prioritize opportunities with stakeholders.
activities: Validate problem statements, expected value and readiness
Prioritize the backlog by impact, effort and dependencies

weeks.title: First solution definition
weeks.focus: Select and scope a focused optimization.
activities: Define scope, owners, dependencies and measurable success criteria
Create an initial delivery and adoption plan

weeks.title: Build and launch
weeks.focus: Move the first optimization or pilot into delivery.
activities: Build and launch the selected practical AI optimization
Communicate the intended workflow and support model

weeks.title: Measure and learn
activities: Collect evidence of business value and user feedback
Document lessons and adjust the delivery approach

weeks.title: Six-month backlog
weeks.focus: Turn validated discovery into a credible next-stage plan.
activities: Complete and prioritize the six-month opportunity backlog
Align assumptions and dependencies with relevant leaders

weeks.title: Roadmap and operating model
weeks.focus: Establish the path for continued AI transformation.
activities: Align a high-level roadmap for delivery, adoption and culture
Define repeatable intake, prioritization, delivery and knowledge-sharing routines
